questions.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It proves the article has reached its final sentence.
It summarizes the first phase before the article moves to further analysis.
It introduces a completely unrelated example.
It means the following claim is uncertain.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 总结词可以出现在文章中段，不能凭Overall就判断是最后一句；unrelated example是引例功能，与概括相反；Overall不表达不确定性，uncertain更接近possibly/apparently等语气词。

questions.q: If the wind weakens before noon, the ferry could conceivably resume service this afternoon, but the operator has made no promise. Conceivably most nearly means:
o: 必然地
有这种可能，但不能确定
故意地
表面上地

exp.trans: 如果中午前风势减弱，渡轮今天下午有可能恢复运营，但运营方没有作出任何保证。
exp.structure: if从句给出条件：the wind weakens before noon。主句：the ferry + could resume + service；conceivably修饰could resume，降低确定性。but后面的no promise进一步说明并不确定。
exp.other: weaken 减弱；ferry 渡轮；resume service 恢复运营；operator 运营方。
exp.meaning: conceivably = 可以设想地、有可能地，强调可能存在但远未确定。
exp.rest: 必然地接近certainly/inevitably，语气过强；故意地是deliberately/intentionally；表面上地是apparently/superficially，均不符合could...but no promise的弱可能语境。

questions.target: subject A to B / be subjected to
questions.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.q:
The cleaner deliberately subjected the curtains to a steam treatment yesterday.
要保留“昨天实际施加了处理”的含义，哪句被动改写准确？
o: The curtains are subject to changes in fashion.
The curtains were exempt from treatment yesterday.
The curtains were subjected to a steam treatment by the cleaner yesterday.
The curtains are suitable for steam treatment.

exp.trans: 清洁人员昨天特意对窗帘做了蒸汽处理。被动句：窗帘昨天被清洁人员进行了蒸汽处理。
exp.structure: 主动简单句：The cleaner（主语）+ subjected（谓语）+ the curtains（宾语）+ to a steam treatment。→ 把宾语the curtains提升为被动句主语，把subjected改成were subjected，并用by保留施事：The curtains were subjected to a steam treatment by the cleaner yesterday。
exp.other: cleaner 清洁人员；curtain 窗帘；deliberately 特意地；steam treatment 蒸汽处理。
exp.meaning: subject A to B表示使A经历B；变成被动结构就是A be subjected to B，实际处理过程仍然保留。
exp.rest: are subject to changes in fashion：说窗帘可能受时尚变化影响，不是昨天被处理的事件。were exempt from treatment：免于处理，与原文相反。are suitable for steam treatment：适合做处理，只表示适宜性，不能证明处理发生过。

questions.target: 社会暗示 / 满意度推断
questions.skill: 社会信息 ≠ 直接批评
questions.q: A workplace culture repeatedly celebrates employees who stay late, and workers who leave on time are often reminded that “real commitment means sacrifice.” What is most safely suggested?
o: Workers who leave on time are formally punished every day.
The culture may make some workers question whether they are committed enough.
Employees who stay late are always more productive.
Managers ignore workers who leave on time.

exp.trans: 一种职场文化反复赞美加班员工，而准时下班的人经常被提醒“真正的投入意味着牺牲”。最稳妥的推断是：这种文化可能让一些人怀疑自己是否足够投入。
exp.structure: 主句1：A workplace culture + celebrates + employees。who stay late修饰employees。主句2：workers who leave on time + are reminded + that从句。that从句给出被灌输的信息。题目要从这种持续信息推断心理影响，而不是擅自添加处罚事实。
exp.other: workplace culture 职场文化；commitment 投入/忠诚；sacrifice 牺牲；question whether 怀疑是否。
exp.meaning: 反复接收到某种价值信息，最直接支持的是“可能影响自我判断/满意度”，不等于已经遭受正式批评或惩罚。
exp.rest: formally punished every day加入原文没有的正式处罚；always more productive把价值宣传偷换成生产率事实；ignore与“are often reminded”相反。

questions.target: come right out and say / frank
questions.q: Instead of giving a vague excuse for the exhibition's cancellation, the curator came right out and said that ticket sales had been too low. This response was:
o: evasive
frank
impulsive
indifferent

exp.trans: 这位策展人没有用含糊的借口解释展览取消，而是直接说票卖得太少了。这种回应是坦率的。
exp.structure: Instead of giving...是介词短语作对比背景。主干：the curator（主语）+ came right out and said（谓语）+ that从句（宾语）。that ticket sales had been too low说明她直接说出的真实原因。
exp.other: vague excuse 含糊的借口；curator 策展人；cancellation 取消；ticket sales 票房/售票量。
exp.meaning: come right out and say = 直截了当地说；语气上对应frank，而不是回避。
exp.rest: evasive表示闪烁其词、回避，和instead of a vague excuse相反；impulsive强调冲动行为；indifferent表示冷漠、不在意，原句没有这种态度。

questions.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
questions.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
questions.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

questions.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
questions.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

questions.q: After a two-hour presentation, Maya said, “Well, at least the slides were readable.” Her remark is best described as:
o: faint praise
earnest approval
open hostility
sufficient evidence

diag.1: earnest approval 是真诚而明确的赞许；“at least...”只给了很弱的一点肯定。
diag.2: 这句话并非直接敌意攻击，而是非常有限、勉强的表扬。
diag.3: evidence 是“证据”，不是评价语气。

exp.trans: 听完一场两小时的演讲后，Maya 说：“嗯，至少幻灯片还看得清。”这句话最适合形容为“勉强的赞扬”。
exp.structure: Maya（主语）+ said（谓语）+ 引语（内容）。问句 Her remark is best described as... 中 is described是被动谓语，不是is加形容词表语。引语主干为the slides were readable；at least限制了肯定的力度。
exp.other: presentation 演讲/展示；readable 易读的；remark 评论；at least 至少。
exp.meaning: faint praise = 勉强的、力度很弱的赞扬。这里 faint 的核心是“微弱的、不强的”。
exp.rest: earnest approval = 真诚、明确的赞成，语气过强；open hostility = 公开敌意，不符合；sufficient evidence = 充分证据，词义类别都不对。只有 faint praise（力度很弱的赞扬）符合 at least 的保留语气。

subject.target: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: 需要写一句仍适用的票务规则：“发车时间可能调整。”这里只说明可能性，不报告已经执行的处理。哪句准确？
o: Departure times were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday.
Departure times are subject to change.
Departure times are subjected to a detailed inspection every morning.
Departure times are immune to change.

exp.trans: Departure times are subject to change：发车时间可能发生调整。
exp.structure: Departure times（主语）+ are（系动词）+ subject to change（表语）。这里是规则或可能状态，不是在叙述谁已经对时刻表做了什么处理。
exp.other: departure 出发；adjustment 调整；inspection 检查；be immune to 不受……影响。
exp.meaning: be subject to在这条规则中表示可能受变化影响。be subjected to通常强调某对象被施加了某个过程。
exp.rest: were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday：报告昨天实际经历了反复调整，时态和事件性质均不符。are subjected to a detailed inspection：说每天被施加检查过程，inspection也不是时间可能调整。are immune to change：表示不受变化影响，与题意相反。

social-message-inference.skill: 被灌输信息 ≠ 被直接批评
social-message-inference.q: At a school, the wall of honour lists only perfect test scores. A pupil who has improved greatly still asks, “Does my progress count if I never appear on that wall?” Which inference is best supported?
o: The pupil has been personally insulted by every teacher.
The display may lead the pupil to doubt the value of improvement without perfection.
The school has failed to display any test scores.
Every pupil with a perfect score has made greater progress.

exp.trans: 一所学校的荣誉墙只列满分成绩。一名进步很大的学生仍问：“如果我从未登上那面墙，我的进步还算数吗？”最稳妥的推断是：这种展示可能让他怀疑没有满分的进步是否有价值。
exp.structure: 第一句：the wall of honour + lists + only perfect test scores。第二句：A pupil + asks + 引语；who has improved greatly修饰pupil。引语里if从句给出没有上榜这一条件。学生的问题体现了对进步价值的怀疑。
exp.other: wall of honour 荣誉墙；perfect score 满分；progress 进步；count 有价值/算数。
exp.meaning: 社会信息可以通过展示与选择标准传递，并影响自我评价；不需要出现直接人身批评。
exp.rest: personally insulted无直接侮辱证据，every teacher还扩大范围；failed to display any scores与列出满分矛盾；greater progress把最终成绩偷换成进步幅度。

directness-modifier.skill: 副词修饰范围 + straight up
directness-modifier.q: When reporters asked why the product launch had been delayed, the engineer was surprisingly straight up: “We underestimated the testing time.” Her manner was best described as:
o: frank
impulsive
ceremonial
hostile

exp.trans: 记者问产品为什么延期发布时，这位工程师出人意料地直截了当：“我们低估了测试所需的时间。”她的表达方式最适合形容为坦率。
exp.structure: 主句：the engineer（主语）+ was（系动词）+ surprisingly straight up（表语）。surprisingly修饰straight up，回答“出人意料地怎么样”。冒号后的直接引语具体证明她没有遮掩原因。
exp.other: product launch 产品发布；delay 推迟；underestimate 低估；testing time 测试时间。
exp.meaning: straight up在这里表示坦率、直截了当；surprisingly只表示这种坦率令人意外，不等于“冲动”。
exp.rest: impulsive表示冲动、未经充分考虑就行动，通常描述decision/action；ceremonial表示仪式性的；hostile表示敌对的。三者都不能由“直接承认低估测试时间”推出。

nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.q:
Residents who discovered that the shared gate was unlocked called the caretaker.
按“主句主语中心词 / who从句谓语 / 主句谓语”的顺序，哪组正确？
o: Residents / discovered / called
the shared gate / discovered / was
Residents / was unlocked / discovered
the caretaker / called / discovered

exp.trans: 发现公共大门没有锁上的住户给管理员打了电话。
exp.structure: 简单句①Residents called the caretaker. ②Residents discovered something. ③The shared gate was unlocked. → 把③接在discovered后：Residents discovered that the shared gate was unlocked. → 把重复的Residents换成who并嵌入①：Residents [who discovered [that the shared gate was unlocked]] called the caretaker。主句完整主语包含who从句，中心词是Residents。
exp.other: resident 住户；shared 共用的；unlocked 没锁上的；caretaker 管理员。
exp.meaning: 发现这件事的是住户；没有锁上的是大门；打电话给管理员的还是住户。三个小句的主语和谓语不能串层。
exp.rest: the shared gate只在that从句中作主语，不能升为主句主语。was unlocked属于that从句，discovered属于who从句；两者都不是主句谓语。the caretaker是called的宾语，不是发现大门未锁的人。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: The healthier seedlings caused the gardeners to provide shade.
Shade provided by the gardeners reduced the seedlings' exposure to heat.
The seedlings protected the gardeners from the heat.
The heat was reduced because the seedlings dried out.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: healthier seedlings caused...把结果当成原先行动的原因；seedlings protected gardeners交换了保护者与被保护者；heat was reduced because...反转因果，还把减少高温暴露偷换成降低环境温度。

faint.q:
After years in the sunlight, only a faint line remained on the old map.
这里 faint 最接近哪种意思？
o: 神圣的
突然出现的
隐约的、不清晰的
故意伪造的

exp.trans: 经过多年日晒，旧地图上只剩下一条隐约可见的线。
exp.structure: After years in the sunlight是时间背景。only a faint line（主语）+ remained（不及物谓语）；on the old map是地点状语。
exp.other: sunlight 阳光；remain 留下、仍然存在；line 线条；after years 多年之后。
exp.meaning: faint在这里是微弱、不明显的；与faint praise中赞扬力度很弱具有相近的语义核心。
exp.rest: 神圣的常用holy/sacred；圣人是saint，不是faint。突然出现的可说sudden，重点是发生速度，不是清晰度。伪造的可说forged/fake，描述真伪，原句没有这种信息。

faint.q:
Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project “not entirely useless” struck the team as faint praise.
哪句改写最准确？
o: The team heard an enthusiastic celebration of the project.
The comment offered only a very weak form of approval.
The comment proved that the project had failed completely.
The team was told that the project had won an award.

exp.trans: 把志愿者历时六个月的修复项目说成“并非完全没有用”，让团队觉得这只是很勉强的赞扬。
exp.structure: Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project ‘not entirely useless’是整个动名词短语主语；struck是谓语；the team是宾语；as faint praise表示给团队留下何种印象。短语内部call A B：称A为B。
exp.other: restoration 修复；entirely 完全；strike sb as sth 给某人以某种印象；approval 赞许。
exp.meaning: faint praise并非赞扬完全不存在，而是肯定得很有限，甚至暗含保留意见。
exp.rest: enthusiastic celebration表示热情赞颂，力度过强；had failed completely表示彻底失败，把微弱肯定改成全面否定；had won an award表示获奖，原文没有提供获奖事实。
